headline: Grab free-agent RB Aaron Jones (MIN) for your open bench spot now, no bid needed — Jordan Mason is Questionable (thumb) for Sunday 10 AM PT at Chicago.
summary: Danny's starting lineup is already optimal this week — nobody on it is flagged, and Judkins and Shakir correctly hold the FLEX spots on volume over Lloyd and Tucker. The only clean move is a free add: Aaron Jones is the healthy half of a near-even Vikings backfield split with Mason banged up, and it costs nothing to grab. Drew Lock isn't yet showing as a free agent in the data despite reports he starts for Seattle, so he's on watch rather than an add until the sweep confirms it.

adds.why: Tier 3 speculative bench RB — free, fills Danny's one open bench spot, no cost either way.
adds.evidence: Today's room shows Jones RB1 and Mason RB2 (Questionable, thumb) for MIN's Sun 10:00 AM game at CHI; Jones carries no injury flag. Reports dated Sept 15, 2026 say Jones and Mason split reps almost evenly in week 1 (29 vs 30 snaps) with Mason now added to the injury report, so Jones is positioned to see extra work if Mason sits.

flags.what: IR, high ankle sprain (hurt Sept 9); reports since Sept 11 put him out at least 4 weeks, targeting a week 8 return vs Miami.
RB2 in TB's backfield behind Bucky Irving; per Sept 2026 reports he's the passing-down/change-of-pace piece in Tampa Bay's two-back 'pony package', not a lead role.

watch.what: Reported the Week 2 starter with Sam Darnold out (soft-tissue injury, no firm timeline, per Sept 15 reports); not yet showing as a free agent in the data, but grab him if he surfaces — he'd fix the week-6 bye overlap between Burrow and Willis.
Questionable, thumb, for Sunday vs CHI; if he sits, Aaron Jones becomes the clear early-down back in Minnesota.
Dropped by HappyChappy18 Sept 16 while Questionable with a hamstring injury; not worth a claim while hurt, and Danny has no bench-TE need right now.

alerts.title: ➕ Add Aaron Jones (MIN RB), free
alerts.body: Jordan Mason is Questionable (thumb) for Sunday's game at Chicago. Aaron Jones is the healthy half of MIN's near-even backfield split — add him now for your open bench spot, no bid needed.
